entities.name: Yosei
entities.description: Legendary ryuu divine dragon who protected the plains of Kamigawa and guarded Eiganjo; died in the Kami War and was reincarnated as Ao.

entities.name: Ao
entities.description: Male dragon spirit reincarnation of Yosei, known as the Dawn Sky.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: City and castle guarded by Yosei.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Great Serpent who tore away half of Yosei's body.

entities.name: Akki
entities.description: Invading hordes Yosei defended Eiganjo against.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: Sacred tree beneath which Yosei lay dormant in an egg.

events.summary: Konda summons Yosei to battle O-Kagachi, who tears half his body away.
events.quote: Yosei suffered a grievous injury that left half of his body torn away

events.summary: Yosei defends Eiganjo Castle against the invading akki and perishes.
events.quote: Ultimately, Yosei perished after valiantly protecting the castle.

events.summary: After fifty years dormant in an egg beneath Boseiju, Yosei is reborn as Ao.
events.quote: His reincarnation took the form of Ao

events.summary: Haunted by his death, Ao refuses to resume protecting rebuilt Eiganjo but sometimes intervenes against extreme injustices.
events.quote: Ao initially refused to resume his role as protector of Eiganjo

relations.quote: served as the guardian spirit of Eiganjo

relations.note: O-Kagachi's wounds led to his death.
relations.quote: his brutal death at the hands of O-Kagachi
His reincarnation took the form of Ao
